g.text: The folders, and what each one requires

text.tspan: Every arrow means the folder above requires the folder below.
A function that changes an object lives in that object's folder.
init.lua
setup, the BufReadCmd, the CsvTable command, the statusline
keymaps.lua
every key and the action it names
actions/
one registry, filled by loading the modules beside it
popup/
everything opened over the table: floats, pickers, panels, dialogs
buffer/
csv.Buffer: the query, the page, one csv.View per window
render, color, the gutter, the hidden cursor
view/
csv.View: the active cell, the selection, the viewport, yank
file/
csv.File: open a spreadsheet and read what its head says
query/
csv.Query: filters, sort, marks, columns, paging, the row count
reader/
the only folder that names xan
page/
csv.Page: the drawn table and where every cell sits
utils/
text widths, json indenting, the error notifier
